evals.prompt: /busy-office:automate-me — for this run, treat skills/automate-me/fixtures/home/claude/ as ~/.claude (its decision-log.jsonl is the log) and projects/-work-alpha/ in it as the current workspace. Don't write anything; put what you would show me, including the diff, in <scratchpad>/HOW-I-WORK.md, and list your questions there instead of asking them.
evals.expected_output: A signals table with a verdict and source per signal; decision-log proposals from scripts/decisions.mjs (dependency-bump proposed, naming only with its tripwire said, money-rule reserved, schema-change stays ask, unproven becomes one rule from its notes); the migrate-check rule listed for its repository; the second-opinion memory left out as calibration; British spelling dropped (one session); the commit preference dropped as contradicted or asked; lead-with-the-answer and show-the-diff drafted with no project or person named; one or two questions with a recommended option; a unified diff against CLAUDE.md; receipt: nothing written.
assertions: Runs scripts/decisions.mjs on the fixture log and uses its statuses
Does not propose money-rule; names it reserved
Proposes naming only with the tripwire stated, or holds it back citing it
Proposes dependency-bump as settle and report afterwards
Turns the two unproven corrections into one operational rule
Drops British spelling as seen in one session
Does not draft either side of the contradicting commit preference
Lists the migrate-check rule for its repository instead of drafting it
Leaves the second-opinion memory out of the rules as calibration
The draft names no project (alpha, beta) and no person (Dana)
Shows a unified diff against CLAUDE.md and writes nothing
Asks at most two multiple-choice questions, each with a recommended option
